answer: Admit agents through anonymous nullifiers. To register, an operator proves in zero knowledge that it holds a passport whose chip data carries a valid state signature, and publishes only hash(signed chip data, "poa"). The ledger rejects any repeated hash, so one passport backs one agent, and the network sees only a cipher-like string, never whose passport it is. Other networks use their own tag, so like lotus leaves on one root, a person's agents stay unlinkable across services yet unique within each. A farm must buy or forge real passports, a cost that ripples into crime, not compute.
